description: Read-only. Poll a re-render started by katto_rerender_clip or katto_dub_clip. Returns { status, clip_url, captions_url, dub_urls } — dub_urls is { lang: url } and is where a DUB lands (clip_url stays the undubbed re-render), null otherwise — clip_url is null until status is 'completed'.
name: katto_get_rerender
